name: Clair
description: Static analysis engine that scans container images layer by layer for known vulnerabilities.

envVars.description: Password for Clair's PostgreSQL vulnerability database

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      CLAIR_CONF: /etc/clair/config.yaml
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/etc/clair
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: clair
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: clair
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
